title: Baghdad
sideASummary: Player deck back. No printed text. State 2 side A is the same back.
sideBSummary: Baghdad, 33°18'46"N 44°21'41"E, code P2-03b. Compass has no anchor. One sealed box labeled SEARCH:. The city name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom.

searchBoxes.effectSummary: Gain 2 actions. The printed label is SEARCH:, not a land/sea split. The scratch tells of Hollow Men here preparing hundreds of cages of rats for an unsuspecting city. The effect is immediate. It does not add a companion.

states.summary: SEARCH is scratched. Hollow Men here are preparing hundreds of cages of rats to deliver to an unsuspecting city. Gain 2 actions. Code P2-03b is unchanged. Side A is the player back.

rules: Black Player card for Baghdad. Not a port.
One SEARCH box. State 2 is the scratched face.
Scratching it gives 2 actions immediately. No companion stays on the card.
notes: The recon report puts this card on the Player discard pile when the package is opened.
The scratch panel fills the center. No bullseye upgrade mark is printed.
The word black is not printed on the face. Baghdad is a black city on the region opened by door 62.
